title: Billa Chuha Chase
summary: One kitchen. Three teams. Bring your friends.
description: Play a five-minute Rat vs Cat vs Dog chase with up to 15 players across browser and Android. Join a lobby, choose your role and invite friends; bots fill empty spaces.

controls.label: Move & aim
controls.text: Hold WASD or arrow keys to move and use the mouse to aim. On touch screens, drag the joystick.

controls.label: Abilities
controls.text: Hold Space / E for ability 1 and Q for ability 2, or use the on-screen buttons. You can steer while using an ability.

title: Arrow Catch
summary: Collect cheese and dodge the falling bombs.
description: Guide your mouse around the arena, collect cheese and keep clear of falling bombs. A quick arcade challenge from the Billa Chuha collection.

controls.label: Move
controls.text: Use the arrow keys or the on-screen direction buttons to guide your character.

title: Joystick Catch
summary: Steer, collect cheese and stay out of trouble.
description: A touch-friendly cheese chase. Move around the arena with the joystick, collect cheese and dodge bombs as you keep your run alive.

controls.label: Move
controls.text: Drag the on-screen joystick, or use WASD / arrow keys.

title: Joystick Shooter
summary: Move and aim with independent controls.
description: Collect cheese, dodge danger and fight back. Separate movement and aiming controls let you keep steering while lining up your next shot.

controls.label: Move & aim
controls.text: Use the movement and aiming pads on screen. Keyboard movement also supports WASD / arrow keys.

title: Long Survival
summary: Explore, collect cheese and jump past danger.
description: Take on a longer stage with cheese to collect and danger to avoid. Keep moving and time your jumps to keep the chase going.

controls.label: Move
controls.text: Use WASD / arrow keys or drag the joystick.

controls.label: Jump
controls.text: Press Space or the on-screen Jump button while steering.

title: Jump & Fire
summary: Run, double-jump and shoot through the stage.
description: A mouse-sized platform adventure with double jumps and shots. Move through the stage, collect coins and use the high ground to get past enemies.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: Use A/D or Left/Right to move and W/Up to jump. The joystick also controls movement and jumping.

controls.label: Fire
controls.text: Press Space or hold the on-screen Fire button.

title: Climber
summary: Jump between platforms and climb higher.
description: Collect coins, leap between platforms and keep climbing. Use movement, double jumps and shots to make your way upward.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: Use A/D or Left/Right to move and W/Up to jump, or use the on-screen joystick.

controls.label: Fire
controls.text: Press Space or hold the on-screen Fire button.

title: Moving Stairs
summary: Keep your footing as the platforms move.
description: A platform challenge with moving stairs, coins and enemies. Time your double jumps and use your shots while exploring the stage.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: Use A/D or Left/Right to move and W/Up to jump, or use the on-screen joystick.

controls.label: Fire
controls.text: Press Space or hold the on-screen Fire button.

title: Fighting Arena
summary: Face a reactive opponent in a sword duel.
description: Challenge a bot that approaches, retreats, attacks and evades. Move into range, time your sword attacks and jump away from danger. This arcade extra uses fighter characters.

controls.label: Move & jump
controls.text: Use A/D or Left/Right to move and W/Up to jump, or use the on-screen controls.

controls.label: Attack
controls.text: Press Space or the Attack button. Use Rematch to start another round.

title: Sprite Preview
description: An early image-rendering experiment that displays a test image in a canvas. This is a development demo rather than a scored game.

controls.label: View
controls.text: Open the demo to view the image-rendering canvas.

title: Animation Playground
summary: Try the running and jumping animations.
description: A small character animation playground. Switch between the Run and Jump animations using the on-screen buttons. This is an animation demo, not a climbing game.

controls.label: Try an animation
controls.text: Select Run Animation or Jump Animation using the buttons beside or below the preview.
